name: klippe
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The klippe is a Scottish folkloric being. In Forfarshire it was a small brown-skinned fairy. It prowled the moors and the roadways.

okr.objective: klippe is a brown-skinned Scottish fairy.
key_results: The klippe is a Scottish folkloric being.
It was a brown-skinned dwarfish fairy.
It haunted the moors and roads of Forfarshire.
